thread.title: Qualcomm Stock Jumps As Chipmaker Beats Target | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Qualcomm Stock Jumps As Chipmaker Beats Target | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Wireless chipmaker Qualcomm ( QCOM ) late Wednesday beat Wall Street's target for earnings in its fiscal first quarter, but came up short on sales. Qualcomm stock rose in extended trading.
X The San Diego-based company earned an adjusted $1.20 a share on sales of $4.8 billion in the quarter ended Dec. 30. Analysts expected Qualcomm to earn $1.09 a share on sales of $4.9 billion. In the year-earlier period, Qualcomm earned 98 cents a share on sales of $6.07 billion.
Qualcomm stock jumped 2.5% in after-hours trading on the stock market today . During the regular session, Qualcomm rose 1.6% to 50.17.
For the current quarter, Qualcomm expects to earn an adjusted 70 cents a share on sales of $4.8 billion. That's based on the midpoint of its guidance. Wall Street expected earnings of 69 cents a share on sales of $4.81 billion in the March quarter.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Qualcomm Focusing On Strategic Objectives "Our fiscal first-quarter results reflected continued strength in our semiconductor business, driven by strong product leadership and operating expense management," Chief Executive Steve Mollenkopf said in a news release . "We continue to execute on our strategic objectives, including driving the global transition to 5G, protecting the established value of our technology and inventions and expanding into new industries and product categories."
Qualcomm's protracted legal dispute with customer Apple ( AAPL ) has hurt its financial results. Apple and its contract manufacturers are withholding patent royalty payments to Qualcomm until the dispute over technology licensing terms is resolved.
